verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes a structured REST API reference with per-endpoint pages for listing tasks, cancelling tasks, sending events, sessions, custom tools and polling, and its quickstart shows short copy-paste code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (no try-it console or playground), and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
